requiredEvidence: Link identity uses the stable pokepod- prefix
hardware reports 16 MB flash and the expected AMOLED board variant

verification: application CDC returns with the expected Link identity
device acceptance checks the changed subsystem
host checks and clean build pass
application partition readback matches the release artifact

reuseRequires: exact live Link identity matches the backup record
deployed application digest or preserved-region state is known
verified application or full-flash restore path remains available
preserve: NVS Wi-Fi, Tencent and pairing configuration

flash.preferredStrategy: manifest-verified whole application image at 460800 baud
flash.fallbackStrategy: 65536-byte application chunks at 115200 baud with three bounded attempts

requiredEvidence: CDC Link identity and status return
display, touch, PMU, RTC, IMU, SD and audio checks pass
changed Wi-Fi or BLE behavior is tested when in scope
